name: Carperidine
summary: Carperidine (carbamethidine) is an opioid analgesic drug related to meperidine. It has analgesic and antitussive effects with similar potency to codeine, though several related compounds are significantly more potent.

pharmacology.text: It has analgesic and antitussive effects with similar potency to codeine, though several related compounds are significantly more potent.

uses.en: It has painkilling and cough-suppressing effects, but it is not known to be in current medical use.
uses.zh: 它具有止痛與止咳作用，但目前未知有任何醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它具有止痛与止咳作用，但目前未知有任何医疗用途。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Opioids in general cause drowsiness, nausea, constipation and dependence, and in overdose can slow or stop breathing.
sideEffects.zh: 它對人體的影響所知甚少。一般來說，鴉片類藥物會造成嗜睡、噁心、便秘與依賴，過量時可能使呼吸減慢甚至停止。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它对人体的影响所知甚少。一般来说，鸦片类药物会造成嗜睡、恶心、便秘与依赖，过量时可能使呼吸减慢甚至停止。

fact.en: It is a close relative of pethidine, also called meperidine, the first fully synthetic opioid, made in 1939 by the chemist Otto Eisleb in Germany.
fact.zh: 它是配西汀（又稱美沛立定）的近親。配西汀是第一個完全人工合成的鴉片類藥物，由德國化學家奧托·艾斯勒布在 1939 年合成。
fact.zhHans: 它是配西汀（又称美沛立定）的近亲。配西汀是第一个完全人工合成的鸦片类药物，由德国化学家奥托·艾斯勒布在 1939 年合成。
